page_title: A lightning-fast app switcher for macOS. No frills, just pure speed.

summary.name: Assignee
summary.one_liner: Assignee is a macOS app switcher that lets you assign custom keyboard shortcuts to apps and individual windows for instant switching.
use_cases: Switch between apps with single-key shortcuts
Jump to a specific window among many open windows
Assign custom hotkeys to frequently used apps
Navigate browser or terminal windows quickly
summary.what_it_does:
Assignee automatically creates a Right ⌘ plus first-letter shortcut for every app with no setup. Users can record their own key combinations (⌃ ⌥ ⌘ plus a number or letter) for any app. Pressing ⌃ Tab opens the switcher, and then a number selects the assigned app. It also lists every open window of every app, where pressing a window's number jumps to it and dragging reorders the list.</what_it_does>
